sys_script.description: Thin adapter: when an extraction's disposition transitions to Applied (confirmed), gather the LOA allow-list snapshot diff against the superseded extraction (if any) and delegate to UWTriggerReasonResolver + LOAEvaluationVersionService to create the next loa_evaluation header for every submission_line on the submission. Same table/condition shape as "UW Guideline trigger on extraction confirmed" but kept as a SEPARATE rule on purpose (single-condition/single-action) - it feeds a different consumer with a different allow-list.
sys_script.name: LOA trigger on extraction confirmed
